title: Emily Shea - "Perl Out Loud"
channel: The Perl and Raku Conference - Greenville, SC 2026
summary: Emily Shea, a Fastly engineer with repetitive strain injury, describes using voice dictation as her main way of programming. She covers homophones, custom vocabulary and building her own voice commands to write Perl.
why: HN treats it as a phenomenal demonstration that voice-driven development is viable and as an eye-opener on accessibility-unfriendly coding habits.

quote.text: This video from the article is a phenomenal demonstration of dictation coding
